# ToolRampart

> FastAPI for safe AI tools. Expose Python functions as AI-agent and MCP-compatible tools with scopes, approvals, rate limits, idempotency, isolation, audit logs, and OpenTelemetry.

ToolRampart is an open-source Python developer framework. It is not a chatbot framework, not a full agent framework, and not a LangChain replacement.

## Start Here

- [Overview](https://toolrampart.dev/): Project purpose, install command, and minimal tool example.
- [Quickstart](https://toolrampart.dev/quickstart/): Create a safe tool and run it as an API.
- [Safety Model](https://toolrampart.dev/concepts/safety-model/): Execution pipeline and trust boundary.
- [Tool Policies](https://toolrampart.dev/concepts/policies/): Scopes, approvals, redaction, rate limits, custom policies, timeouts, and isolation.
- [Python Client](https://toolrampart.dev/CLIENT/): HTTP client SDK for invoking tools and resolving approvals.
- [MCP](https://toolrampart.dev/MCP/): Running ToolRampart as an MCP server.
- [Deployment](https://toolrampart.dev/DEPLOYMENT/): Docker Compose, Postgres, Redis, and production notes.
- [Security](https://toolrampart.dev/SECURITY/): Security model, limitations, and operational guidance.
- [Threat Model](https://toolrampart.dev/THREAT_MODEL/): Assets, trust boundaries, threats, and non-goals.
- [Production Checklist](https://toolrampart.dev/PRODUCTION_CHECKLIST/): Production readiness checklist.
- [Release Process](https://toolrampart.dev/RELEASE/): Alpha release gates and publishing steps.

## Examples

- [Read-only SQL Tool](https://toolrampart.dev/examples/read-only-sql/): Safe SELECT-only SQLite tool.
- [CRM Update With Approval](https://toolrampart.dev/examples/crm-update/): Update customer contact data with approval and redaction.
- [GitHub Issue Creator](https://toolrampart.dev/examples/github-issue/): External API tool with rate limits and idempotency.
- [Isolated Long Job](https://toolrampart.dev/examples/isolated-job/): Subprocess-isolated job with killable timeout.
- [Destructive Admin Policy](https://toolrampart.dev/examples/destructive-admin/): Block risky admin actions unless policy conditions pass.
- [MCP Client Usage](https://toolrampart.dev/examples/mcp-client/): How MCP clients should pass approvals and idempotency keys.

## Repository

- GitHub: https://github.com/toolrampart/toolrampart
- PyPI distribution: `toolrampart`
- Python import package: `toolrampart`
- Python: 3.11+

## AI Agent Instructions

- Read [Agent Guide](https://toolrampart.dev/agents/) before generating integration code.
- Always use idempotency keys for write tools.
- Do not bypass `ToolRampart.invoke`, REST invocation, or MCP invocation.
- Do not claim ToolRampart is a sandbox for arbitrary unsafe credentials.
